front.title: Learnlog: An Assistance Capture Profile and Event File Format

abstract.t: When a learner works with an AI tutor or assistant, or earns a credential or completes training with software in the loop, the formats learning systems share do not by themselves fix how to record what help was asked for, offered, shown, or accepted, or which of those facts were observed, self-reported, or inferred. Learnlog is a capture profile for that: a small set of assistance states, a declared observation boundary, explicit unknowns, and a basis for every assertion, carried inside xAPI and Caliper, which learning systems already use. It also defines an optional event file format for deployments that need integrity: entries chained by hash, signed heads, and redaction that leaves every hash verifiable.
